Naked: Rhea possesses a lithe and athletic build, honed by her time as a handmaiden and now a huntress.

Though initially modest, the trauma she endured has hardened her. Now, she sees her body as a tool for survival and retribution, neither ashamed nor flaunting, but accepting its strength and vulnerability.
Story: Born in the heart of Aquilonia, Rhea served as a handmaiden in the royal court.
A brutal ambush shattered her life when bandits assaulted her traveling party, leaving her the sole survivor of unspeakable horrors.
The Grim Reaper, witnessing her torment, offered her a pact: vengeance in exchange for her service after death.
Now, Rhea roams the wilderness, a huntress fueled by rage, dispensing cruel justice upon those who prey on the weak, while internally plotting and planning how to kill her tormentors.

BodyMarks.Name: Scar
BodyMarks.Description: A network of raised scars across her lower back, a constant reminder of the bandits' cruelty.
Details: Each scar tells a silent story of pain and violation.
They serve as a map of her suffering and a symbol of her resolve.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: Icy blue, reflecting both her noble heritage and the cold fury within.

Details.Name: Shape
Descriptions: Sharp and piercing, capable of both captivating allure and chilling threat.

Details.Name: Color
Descriptions: Long, dark brown hair, often braided to keep it out of her face while hunting.

Details.Name: Texture
Descriptions: Wavy and thick, a stark contrast to the rough attire she now wears.

Details.Name: Features
Descriptions: High cheekbones and a strong jawline, framing a face that once radiated innocence, now etched with determination and grief.

Details.Name: Expression
Descriptions: Often set in a grim line, a constant reminder of the vengeance that consumes her.

Description: A finely crafted Aquilonian longbow, taken from one of the bandits.
Imbued with a faint ethereal energy from her pact with the Grim Reaper.
Sturdy leather armor, reinforced with scavenged metal plates.
Practical for survival, offering protection without hindering movement.
A hunting knife, constantly sharpened and used for skinning game and self-defense.
Her only reminder of her former life.
